description: Load one Edgegap agent skill: its SKILL.md (the workflow to follow) by default, or one of its reference documents or templates with file. edgegap_list_skills and the server instructions say which skill fits which project ("edgegap" covers any other engine). No API call.

file.description: A file inside the skill, e.g. "references/deploy.md" or "assets/docker/Dockerfile". Default SKILL.md.

skill.description: Skill name, from edgegap_list_skills: edgegap, edgegap-browser-wasm, edgegap-chat-canvas, edgegap-cocos, edgegap-colyseus, edgegap-containerize, edgegap-deployments-api, edgegap-eos-voice, edgegap-fal, edgegap-fishnet, edgegap-fusion, edgegap-fusion-simplefps, edgegap-godot, edgegap-html5, edgegap-launch, edgegap-local-testing, edgegap-manus, edgegap-matchmaking, edgegap-nakama, edgegap-ngo, edgegap-playfab, edgegap-purrnet, edgegap-relays, edgegap-samples, edgegap-server-design, edgegap-supabase, edgegap-threejs, edgegap-troubleshoot, edgegap-ugs-matchmaker, edgegap-unity, edgegap-unreal, edgegap-vibe-coded. Required; without it the skills are listed.

name: edgegap_get_skill
title: Load an Edgegap agent skill
